thread:
lee: quick follow-up from today's postmortem — we keep losing momentum on remediation tasks. proposal: a tiny canonical tracker row per action item that lives in the postmortem doc and syncs to the oncall tracker.

dana: agree, we need something minimal. last time a bunch of items sat in "triage" forever.

priya: idea: make the template machine-readable so we can auto-create tasks. simple YAML/CSV row at the top of the postmortem. e.g.

```csv
summary,impact,severity,owner,due,deliverable,recurring,notes
"fix autoscaler flapping","some customers, intermittent 5xx","high","@dana","2025-08-01","deploy scaling floor + tests","yes","happens on burst traffic"
```

nate: +1 to machine-readable. also suggest SLAs for remediation: high=48h, medium=7d, low=30d. keeps expectations aligned.

lee: that SLA set looks good to me. also we should define comms cadence in the playbook: IC posts at T+10, T+30, T+60 and then hourly unless status changes. keeps pings consistent.

priya: for IC rotation, can we do a 1-week rotation (Mon-Mon) with a one-day shadow for handoff? we're hiring so keeping overlap helps knowledge transfer.

dana: sounds reasonable. ops oncall still triages first 20-30m then hands to IC if severity >= sev2. we should document that handoff decision and include a checklist.

oncall-bot: note: created reminder POSTM-FOLLOWUP-175010 for lee, due 2025-07-26.

lee: thanks bot. action owners: @dana will own autoscaler fix (due 2025-08-01); @priya will add the machine-readable template and infra hook to create tracker tasks (due 2025-07-24); @nate will run a 6-month recurring-incident sweep and produce a short list (due 2025-08-07). I'll update the playbook with comms cadence + IC rotation (due 2025-07-28).

nate: i'll also add a "recurrence_score" column so we can group cluster issues instead of duplicating tasks.

priya: can someone confirm we want monthly compliance reporting (pct closed within SLA) versus quarterly? monthly helps catch slow-moving backlogs.

dana: monthly please. add to ops dashboard and include in the oncall sync agenda.

lee: quick ask: can infra add a tiny helper that pulls timeline events (incident start, mitigation steps, deploys) into a markdown snippet? would save ~30m on every postmortem.

priya: i'll prototype a script that hits the incident logs and outputs a timeline.md snippet and open a PR to docs by EOD Friday.

nate: last item: for recurring problems, let's create a quarterly "cluster review" where owners propose permanent fixes or product changes. keeps long-term work visible.

lee: perfect. summary of tasks in thread above. reconvene at next oncall sync (Thursday) to confirm tasks exist and dates. ping me if you need to shift deadlines. :thumbsup:
